eligibility_rules.ligand_identity_unresolved: stays in raw data; excluded from the headline aggregation unit
eligibility_rules.state_unknown: excluded from state-stratified aggregation; included in state-agnostic same-site-class aggregation

multi_structure_rule: A unit may contain several structures. It is NEVER silently reduced to a binary. contact_fraction_5A is the primary continuous metric; any/all/majority binaries are produced alongside for comparison and none of them is labelled 'prevalence' on its own.
